```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Write the Table Header manually
cat('<table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">')
cat('<tr style="background-color: #f2f2f2; text-align: left;">
      <th style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">Screenshot</th>
      <th style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">Project</th>
      <th style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">Links</th>
    </tr>')

# 3. Loop through rows
for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  img_url <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", repo_path, "@main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Build Demo link
  user <- gsub("/.*", "", repo_path)
  repo <- gsub(".*/", "", repo_path)
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", user, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  
  cat('<tr>')
  # Raw <img> tag without R's help - this prevents the brackets!
  cat(paste0('<td style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;"><img src="', img_url, '" width="250" alt="Viz Screenshot"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;"><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td style="padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">
              <a href="', demo_url, '" target="_blank">Interactive Demo</a><br><br>
              <a href="', dt$source[i], '" target="_blank">Source Code</a>
            </td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</table>')
